name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2021 in Intrusions
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified 2021 record supports: CISA advisories AA21-110A, AA21-131A, AA21-148A, AA21-200A, AA21-259A, AA21-265A, AA21-291A and AA21-321A, Ireland NCSC's HSE alert, Mandiant's Pulse Connect Secure mapping, and behavior described by Microsoft, Kaseya, Codecov and others. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2021.md. Scores: 100 the source prints the id, 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 40 the behavior is Inferred.
